purpose: Parent-requested discriminant after first preregistered DIFFIMG failure; explicitly a follow-up, not a prospective discovery claim
known_outcome: Primary DIFFIMG quality pull mean -0.861, RMS2.944, heavy tails; SMP no >365d observations
splits: PROB_SNNV19>0.9 versus<=0.9 (if nonempty); report sample support
baseline_holdout: For each SNID and band, divide fixed observing seasons floor((MJD-56474)/365.25) by even/odd parity. Train weighted constant flux baseline on one parity and predict the other, then swap. Require >=5 training points and >=2 heldout. Each observation predicted only from opposite-parity seasons; report remaining objects and rows.
uncertainty: Normalize heldout flux-minus-baseline by sqrt(reported_error^2+formal_weighted_mean_variance). Also separately report conservative max(formal, empirical night-cluster sandwich training-mean variance), using floor(MJD) nights. Neither assumes this estimates all season-scale covariance.
statistics: pooled mean, MAD, RMS and >3/>5 tails
cross_reduction: Compare SMP/DIFFIMG only exact CID,IMGNUM,MJD,BAND matches or unique rounding-compatible match with reported tolerance. Same sky pixels and different calibrations mean reductions are not independent; no quadrature significance of their flux difference.
restriction: No correction applied to cosmology photometry. DIFFIMG offset/noise outcomes cannot be transferred to SMP.
